claims.sentence: Moreover, in an in vivo mouse model of radiation-induced premature ageing, we show that a short-term intervention combining the mitochondrial uncoupler BAM15 with Navitoclax at a dose two orders of magnitude lower than typically used reduces frailty and improves cognitive function for at least 8 months after irradiation.
